course_name_original: Teoría de Estructuras y Construcciones Industriales II
course_name_en: Theory of Structures and Industrial Constructions II
prerequisites: Advanced Elasticity and Strength of Materials
Theory of Structures and Industrial Constructions I (recommended)

learning_outcomes.text: Design of basic structural concrete elements in industrial constructions.
Interpretation and proper use of current regulations in the design and calculation of structural concrete structures.

syllabus_topics: Module I: Previous concepts for the design of concrete structures.
Topic 1. Introduction to the project. Industrial constructions.
Topic 2. Reinforced and prestressed concrete. Historical evolution.
Topic 5. ULS of exhaustion by normal stresses.
Topic 8. ULS of exhaustion by shear.
Topic 9. Introduction to ULS of exhaustion by punching.
Module III: Introduction to advanced aspects of structural concrete.
Topic 12. Introduction to the study of slabs.
Topic 13. Introduction to the study of foundations.
Topic 14. Introduction to the strut-and-tie mechanism.
Topic 15. Introduction to the study of prestressed concrete.
assessment_rules: Continuous assessment consists of three theoretical-practical tests, each contributing 1/3 to the final grade. A minimum of 2.50 points is required in each test; if this condition is not met, the final grade is the average of the tests, capped at 3.00 points. If all tests meet the minimum, the course is approved with an average score of 5.00 points or higher. The second convocation always uses a single assessment method, which is one theoretical-practical test graded from 0 to 10 points.
